input.quote: (f) actual or alleged infringement of any Third Party's Intellectual Property by the Product or by either Party in performing its duties or obligations hereunder with respect to the Product;
input.rationale: SFJ's indemnity at § 12.1.1 (p0687–p0691) has no third-party IP infringement limb, while our indemnity at § 12.1.2(f) (p0695) covers infringement "by the Product or by either Party in performing its duties or obligations hereunder", so we carry IP risk for SFJ's own performance. That is a one-way Customer IP indemnity and fails the fallback. We target the fallback level: preferred would require rewriting our own § 12.1.2 to strip the Product-supply, breach, Protocol, Subject-injury and Commercialization limbs down to Customer-provided content and breach of law, which cannot pass the minimality gate here. The single fallback insertion adds an SFJ IP indemnity with the usual PB modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap; notice, control and cooperation procedure already exists at §§ 12.2.1–12.2.5 and is left untouched.

ops.text: SFJ IP Indemnity. SFJ will indemnify the PB Indemnified Parties from any and all Losses arising or resulting from any Claim by a Third Party alleging that the services or deliverables provided by SFJ under this Agreement infringe or misappropriate such Third Party's Intellectual Property, except to the extent such Claim arises from modifications made by PB, combination of such services or deliverables by PB with items not supplied by SFJ, or SFJ's compliance with specifications provided by PB. SFJ will, at its option, procure for PB the right to continue using the infringing item, modify it or replace it, and if none of the foregoing is available on commercially reasonable terms, refund the amounts paid for it. SFJ's aggregate liability under this Section 12.1.3 will not exceed 3x the annual fees payable under this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an SFJ indemnity for Third Party claims that SFJ's services or deliverables infringe Intellectual Property, with the usual PB modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap. Our playbook does not accept IP infringement risk running one way against us.
proposal.summary: Add SFJ third-party IP infringement indemnity with standard exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and 3x annual fees super-cap
